meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Framework for computational fluid dynamics simulations using Python. Use when running fluid dynamics simulations including Navier-Stokes equations (2D/3D), shallow water equations, stratified flows, or when analyzing turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows. Provides pseudospectral methods with FFT, HPC support, and comprehensive output analysis.

copy.tagline_en: Run fluid dynamics simulations with Python
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run CFD simulations or study fluid mechanics

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Python 编写和运行流体动力学模拟，包括 2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯方程、浅水方程、分层流等。它会生成参数配置、执行模拟，并输出涡量、能谱等分析结果。
howto.when: 当你要求进行流体动力学模拟，或提到纳维-斯托克斯方程、湍流、涡旋动力学、地球物理流等关键词时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write and run fluid dynamics simulations in Python, including 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, and stratified flows. It generates parameter configurations, executes simulations, and outputs analysis results like vorticity and spectra.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run fluid dynamics simulations or mention Navier-Stokes equations, turbulence, vortex dynamics, or geophysical flows.

say_en.text: Help me simulate 2D turbulence with fluidsim, grid 256x256, viscosity 1e-3.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a complete Python script and explain steps.

say_en.text: Use fluidsim's ns2d.strat solver to simulate stratified flow with Brunt-Väisälä frequency 2.0.
say_en.note: Claude will provide parameter setup and run code.
